english: Hmm... quite a spacious,\nlovely town, isn't it.
And yet, this maze-like layout...\nYes, yes — this place looks very "trappable," doesn't it.
Oh, Satoko? That's not good —\nkids should be in bed by now.
Isn't it rude to treat a lady like a child?
Just because you're enjoying a harem situation,\nI'd appreciate it if you didn't get carried away.\nI won't fawn over you that easily.
Harem...?\nI don't really get it, but my apologies.\nWhat are you doing out at this hour?
Good that you understand.\nYou're surprisingly well-mannered.
As for what I'm doing — well, that's a maiden's secret,\nor so I'd say.
By the way, you look free.\nPerfect timing.\nWould you lend me a hand?
Of course, you have no right to refuse.\nConsider it atonement for that rude remark earlier.
Then let's go.\nStarting over there...
...Hm, hm.\nIf I use this corner\nto corner them in that dead end from earlier...
No, no — I'll make this spot just a decoy,\nand save the real fun for last...
Umm...\nWhat have you been doing this whole time?
What do you mean, 'what'...\nIt's obvious, isn't it?
Don't tell me — hide and seek?
Why would I be playing hide and seek\nin the middle of the night?\nI'd like you to think a little before you speak.

Well, in a sense you're close,
or so I'll say.
It's effective for luring out
hidden foes.
Don't tell me — your first errand?
That's right.\nMion asked me to,\nreally, she works people so hard...
Like I'd be running an errand\nin the middle of the night!?\nAnd I can handle an errand on my own!
I'm scouting locations\nto set my traps.
Traps...?\nYou're setting traps around town?
Yes — my traps, my pride and joy.
You never know when an enemy\nmight attack this town.
Especially late at night like this,\nif they attacked while everyone's asleep,\nchaos would be guaranteed...
And then, if my traps were in place,\nthey'd surely come in handy\nin a pinch!
You might have a point...
So when the time comes to set them,\nyou'll help me too.
At any rate, you were a big help today.\nThis is my thanks for helping out.\nHere, take it.
Thank you.
...You've accepted it.\nWell then, I'll be going.\nGood day to you.
...I don't really get it, but it looks like I've been roped into helping.
And this thing she gave me, I wonder what it is...\nWhoa, is this... gum?\nI-it won't come off...
O-hohohoho...
Would you help me again today?
I found a good spot.\nOver there, I should be able to set\nmy greatest trap yet.
Well then, today I'll\nhead on ahead.
...I lost her.\nShe went this way, I'm pretty sure...
Kufu...
Whoa!?
W-what was that just now...
...Click.
BUBERAH!?
No way — is this one of Satoko's traps...?
O-hohohoho...!
You fell for it!
And what a spectacular way to fall for it...\nIt makes all the effort I put into setting it\nworthwhile.
'Why would you do this,' you ask?\nWhy, for a test, of course.
You seem a little slow, but\nif you fall for them this spectacularly,\nthey're clearly practical enough.
Truly, you've done\nsplendid work.
I got praised...?\nI don't really get it, but I'm happy.
Urgh...\nDon't tell me you're one of those masochist types\nwho enjoys being attacked...?
More importantly, help me...
Oops, my apologies.\nI'll help you right now.
Just a flick of the wrist...\nAnd we're good.
Though it shouldn't have been that painful.\nThere's love in my traps, you know.
Love aside, I've learned that\nSatoko's trap skills are the real deal.
You're good at flattery.\nBut I'll thank you anyway.
Thanks to you, the test was a complete success.
At this rate I'll set them all over town...\nand eventually make it my garden.
O-hohohoho...!\nI can't wait!
(Satoko... what a fearsome kid!)
...Huh?\nWhere did he go, I wonder.
I was hoping you'd help me\nset traps again today...
(Helping, he says — at that rate\nI don't have enough bodies for this...\nKnock on wood, knock on wood...)
...Hm?\nWhat's that...
I seee, so you plan to run from me.\nYou've got guts.
Good thing I already took measures\nassuming you'd think that...
This is weird... where did my thing go...?\nWithout my thing, I...
Could you be\nlooking for your thing?
Don't worry.\nYour thing is in my protection.
Yes... 'If you want it back,\ncome and take it!' —\nthat's how it goes, no?
Tch... why go so far just to drag me in?
A reason it has to be you?\nEven asking is boorish.
I couldn't possibly use\nthe frail young ladies as test subjects\nfor my traps.
Which leaves only you.\nFortunately, you seem to have\na real talent for getting caught in traps.
Like the deeds of some evil scientist...
Wh-what did you say!?\nOf all things to call me — a deranged\nmad scientist...!
I was thinking of going easy on you,\nbut you've snapped my last nerve!
Now, if you want this back,\ntry and catch me!
I need that thing...\nI guess I have no choice but to chase her.
Oh my, at this rate\nshe'll catch up to me.\nWhat to do, what a problem~.
I could catch her at a dash, but... that composure...\nI'm betting there's a trap on this straight path too...
If I charge straight through, the traps won't be able to react in time!
Oh my...\nA head-on breakthrough against me —\ndo you know no fear?
You spotted the tiny opening\nwhen a trap activates.\nHoweveeer...!
Whatever happens, if I just jump right over it!\nHup!
You read that there'd be something on the ground, did you?\nBut...!
Too naive!
GFUH!
I've got that much covered.\nYou miscalculated,\nO-hohohoho!
Reading my opponent's mind\nand predicting their actions from it is my specialty.\nThis much is a piece of cake!
The fearsome Satoko... *thud*.
My victory this time.\nNext time, please do try\nto break through my traps.
Well then, good day to you!
What's wrong?\nI'm over here, you know?
Oh my, is that wise?\nCharging in so carelessly...
GWAH!
I'm it, over heeere~!
HEBUSHI!?
Butt-spanky, spanky~!\nO-hohohoho...
Ababababa...!
M-my, you're quite the wreck...\nA little pitiful, even.
Still, to fall for\nabsolutely every single trap...
...Don't tell me\nyou're falling for them\non purpose...?
Th-that's not it...!
Then you must have been born\nunder such a star.
But at this rate,\nthere's no sport in it at all.
Some plan... I know!
In our club, whenever something happens,\nthe rule is that a penalty game gets carried out.
If we decide on a penalty game here too,\nyou'll feel like actually trying\nto dodge.
Bring it on.
Quite hairy, covered in cat hair!\nThis is getting fun!
No way.
And whose mouth is saying that?\nPoke poke~.
Urgh... F-fine, I get it!
But — if I manage to slip through every one of your traps,\ndo you get a penalty game too, Satoko?
Hm... quite right.\nIt wouldn't be fair otherwise.
Think up a penalty game for me,\nwould you? Not that I expect\nto lose, of course.
Now I can go all out\nwith even more gusto.\nFufufu...
I may have made a terrifying promise...
(Today I'll beat Satoko!\nI've even thought up a strategy...!)
Oh my?\nYour eyes look different today.
...I seee.\nSo you won't just take it lying down\nanymore, is that it?
Indeed, at this rate\npeace will never return...
A fight with your back to the river, so to speak.\nI'm looking forward to it...\nThat's when I can get serious too!
You've chased me here,\nbut in a place like this...
Hah!?\nTh-that is... no way!?
You're closing your eyes!?
Then that seals off my ability to read your mind,\nand without being fooled by what you see,\nyou can press forward — is that it!?
O-ohohoho!\nYou think you can slip through MY traps\nwith something like that...!
Th-that's impossible!?\nAre you seeing with your mind's eye or something!?
Wh-what is this...\nEvery single trap... unscathed...
Don't you see?\nWhy I was able to conquer your traps, Satoko...
Getting caught all those times taught me\nyour habits when it comes to setting traps!
Wh-whAAAT did you say!?
I thought I was trapping you,\nbut somewhere along the way,\nI'd been trapped myself...
Now then, you've been a bit naughty.\nI'll be taking that back, Satoko.
Eek...\nP-please let me off!
...I wasn't very mature about it either.\nLet's call it even, shall we.
No way! Give it back!
N-nooo! Don't touch me in weird places!
Ah, s-sorry...
...Gotcha.\nToo naive!
AUH!
Hmph, I got one back...
Still, it was my complete defeat.\nThanks to you,\nI understand my own immaturity well.
Here, I'll return this to you.
Ah, thank goodness... this... without this pillow,\nI just can't sleep. Nuzzle nuzzle.
E-eew, that's kind of creepy...
Anyway, that's good.\nFrom tonight, sleep soundly\nand fix that sleep deprivation!
Well then, good day to you!
...Hmm?\nI feel like I'm forgetting something.
Satoko.
Hyah!?\nD-don't call out to me so suddenly!
I-I'm not surprised or anything...\nWhat is it?
...Dinner together?\nOh, that's what it was... phew.
Th-that's nothing.\nFine, I'll grace you with my company.
Oh, that smells nice...\nWhat's for dinner tonight?
Baguette and pumpkin soup, it says.\nPump... um?
That means pumpkin.
P-pumpkin!?
N-no, I can't!\nI-I can't eat this!
Um... yes, that's right!\nI hate pumpkin!
This, this is like\nslurping a whole pumpkin!\nIsn't it!
You're still growing, Satoko,\nso you should eat it.\nDoesn't it look tasty?
Pumpkin, you see, is rich in vitamins and minerals,\ngreat for rough skin too —\na truly excellent vegetable!
Uwaaah... for someone with amnesia,\nwhy do you know all THAT stuff.\nUwaaaan!
(Crying this hard!?\nBut disliking food is bad, so here...)
I'll make you eat it even by force! Here!
MMF!?
Then I'll have yours.\nStill, I never knew Satoko was such a little kid...
Mm!?
That's a mean way to put it!\nF-fine, I'll eat it for you!
...Nom.
Munch munch...
...Sweet.
See? Being picky never pays.
Th-this just happened to be\nseasoned in an easy-to-eat way,\nis all!
Honestly, forcing someone to eat —\nthat's practically a penalty game.
(Hm? Penalty game? ...Ahh!)
Did you just remember?
All too clearly...
Urgh — if I slip through your traps,\na penalty game...
I'd managed to forget, and then\nI go and remind myself with something like this!\nMy mouth slipped...!
I understand...\nI have my pride too.\nI'll keep the promise.
By next time, think up\nthe penalty... okay?
And pumpkin is... out, got it?
Y-you came.
I'm prepared.\nCome, give me whatever punishment you will.
The thing is, I still...\ndon't know what to make you do.
...Huh?\nYou haven't thought of anything?
I-is that so.\nPhew... I mean, whatever you do to me,\nI'm fine with it!
So, how long are you going to stand there spacing out?\nI'm going to bed, you know —\nisn't it rude in front of a lady?
I gave you your pillow back,\nand now you're going to say you can't sleep\nwithout me?
...That sounds good.
...Huh?\nNo way...
Y-you mean sleep next to me!?\nThat's the penalty game... urgh.
F-fine, I understand.\nI'm the loser, so it can't be helped...
H-hey...\nAren't you a little too close...?
Y-yes...
I can't sleep...\nHaving a gentleman next to me\nis making me rather nervous...
Huh?\nNo, I'm not usually alone.\nI'm with Rika.
Yes, that's right.\nSince my bro... my brother ran away from home,\nI've been living with Rika.
Believe it or not, I can cook,\nand I can get by\njust fine on my own...
So there's not the slightest reason\nfor you to worry about me...
You're such a good girl for being so little, Satoko. Good girl.
Wh—\nDon't treat me like a child!\nHow many times do I have to say it!
!? Wh-what are you crawling in here for!?
Well, you're so cute I wanted to hug you... fmgh!
You pervert!\nStay away from meee!
Honestly, you really are something...
But you — there's definitely something about you...\nN-no, never mind!
I-I'm going to sleep now,\nso you go to sleep too, right now!
'Just like Nii-nii'...?\nWhat's gotten into me...?
What in the world...?\nWhere... am I?
It says 'Café SHC'.\nWell, let's go in for now.
Welcome, come on in!
D-don't stare at me so much, would you?\nIt's... embarrassing...
Satoko...?\nThat outfit!?
It's called cosplay, apparently.\nI prepared it for you.
...No, that's too presumptuous of me.\nI owe you an apology for everything so far.
All those traps I set on you...\nthey were, in a way, love turned inside-out...
You know, that thing where you tease\nthe one you like...
For me to finally realize it...\nabout myself...
(Wh-this is a love confession from Satoko\n— is that what's happening here!?)
Ufufu, of course this\nisn't a trap.
Rather, before I knew it, I'd been splendidly\ncaught by your existence...
Please accept my feelings.
...Of course!
I'm happy...
Then — my final trap, as a present.\nPlease pull this string.
I just pull this, right?
Yes, give it a good pull!
Here I go... heave!
...H-huh? What's this?\nSatoko, where are you—?
WAAAAAH...!
O-hohohoho...\nSloppy to the very last...!
I'm glad...!\nYou've finally noticed.
What in the world am I...
I'm sorry...\nYou fell into my trap\nand were out cold for a little while.
(Huh — so the Satoko from before was a dream...!?)
I'm really, truly sorry.\nI got carried away\nand couldn't hold back...
I never properly\ntold you, did I.
I have an older brother named Satoshi\nwho's run away from home...
Being with you,\nyou started to remind me of Nii-nii somehow...
I was just so happy, I got a little\ncarried away... how embarrassing.
Don't be embarrassed...\nI'm happy to be thought of that way.
Thank you... very much.
Um — from now on, when it's just the two of us...\nmay I call you\nNii-nii...?
Yes, of course.
Thank you...\nYou're kind, Nii-nii.
